findings.source_quote: τοὺς δὲ ἑτέρους οὓς ἑώρακας πολλοὺς κειμένους, μὴ ὑπάγοντας εἰς τὴν οἰκοδομήν, οὗτοι οἱ μὲν ἐψωριακότες εἰσίν, οἱ ἐγνωκότες τὴν ἀλήθειαν, μὴ ἐπιμείναντες δὲ ἐν αὐτῇ μηδὲ κολλώμενοι τοῖς ἁγίοις· διὰ τοῦτο ἄχρηστοί εἰσιν.
findings.english_quote: And the others you saw—many lying there, not going into the building—these are the scabbed ones[h]: they came to know the truth, but did not remain in it, nor did they cling to the holy ones[k]; therefore they are useless.
findings.issue: The English identifies all the many others lying outside the building as the scabbed ones. The source's οἱ μὲν introduces the scabbed category within those others, followed by further categories in the subsequent paragraphs. This loses the subgroup distinction and extends the scabbed category's description to the entire remaining group.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed wording for fresh review: “And the others you saw—many lying there, not going into the building: among these, the scabbed ones are those who came to know the truth but did not remain in it or cling to the holy ones; therefore they are useless.” Preserve the distinction between the larger group and this particular category.

findings.source_quote: τοὺς δὲ ἑτέρους οὓς ἑώρακας πολλοὺς κειμένους, μὴ ὑπάγοντας εἰς τὴν οἰκοδομήν, οὗτοι οἱ μὲν ἐψωριακότες εἰσίν, οἱ ἐγνωκότες τὴν ἀλήθειαν, μὴ ἐπιμείναντες δὲ ἐν αὐτῇ μηδὲ κολλώμενοι τοῖς ἁγίοις· διὰ τοῦτο ἄχρηστοί εἰσιν.
findings.english_quote: The many others you saw lying there, not going into the building, are the scabbed ones[h]. They came to know the truth but did not remain in it or cling to the holy ones[k]. That is why they are useless.
findings.issue: Independently compared with the source, this wording makes the entire group of many unused stones scabbed. The source's οἱ μὲν distinguishes the scabbed category within that group. The simplified edition consequently applies this category's moral description to all the others rather than preserving the classification developed across the following paragraphs.
findings.suggested_revision: Proposed wording for fresh review: “You saw many other stones lying there, not going into the building. Among them, the scabbed ones are people who came to know the truth but did not remain in it or cling to the holy ones. That is why they are useless.”

summary: Both editions require revision to preserve the subgroup distinction in VI.2. Otherwise, clause-by-clause review found the source's difficult assertions, negations, necessary wealth-reduction conditions, speaker changes, God/Lord distinctions, and plural imperative retained. The bracketed supplement and disputed closing interpretation are disclosed. Witness notes are compatible with the supplied attributed reports; this assessment does not authenticate unseen images or certify an exhaustive collation. Proposed replacements remain subject to fresh review.
